title: liquiditybot — problems
description: PROBLEMS — what needs attention: posture, the pager conditions as live numbers, faults & rejections, staleness, the risk brakes, and the audit trail's own health. Looking empty is good.

panels.title: Overall posture
panels.description: The whole bot's operating state in one word. ARMED is normal; anything else is why the bot is holding back.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Halted?
panels.description: The master circuit breaker. 'clear' is healthy; HALTED blocks all NEW risk while exits keep running.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: New trades blocked?
panels.description: The data watchdog's entry gate. BLOCKED means the feeds are too stale or divergent to trust with new money.

defaults.noValue: watchdog block not in this status write

panels.title: Active faults
panels.description: Latched fault conditions right now. Zero is the only good number; each fault names its reason code in the audit trail.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Risk firewall
panels.description: Last line of defense before an order leaves the bot. TRIPPED means it latched a violation and refuses new risk.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: Seconds since the bot last wrote its status. Past 5 minutes every tile on this board describes the past - read it first.

defaults.noValue: ⚠ no series — exporter/pusher, not the bot

panels.title: Model worse than naive by
panels.description: Mirrors the REPO's copy of the Brier rule (liquiditybot_brier_alert.yaml: above 0.03 for 15 minutes pages). Red here means the page is coming. Two things this tile cannot see: the live instance's rule can drift from the repo copy, and when the series is ABSENT the alert holds green (noDataState: OK) while this tile shows its empty-state text instead.

defaults.noValue: window filling (<15 scored closes) or judge down

panels.title: Trades the judge has scored
panels.description: The Brier tiles and pager wake at 15 model-scored closes. Zero or absent here is why the tile beside this one is empty - and if it stays absent while trades close, the judge is dead, which the pager cannot see.

defaults.noValue: window filling (<15 scored closes) or judge down

panels.title: Drift stuck while degraded
panels.description: Mirrors the REPO's copy of the drift rule (liquiditybot_drift_alert.yaml): feature drift above 30% WHILE the governor is degraded, held 30 minutes, pages. The live instance's rule can drift from the repo copy.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Model governor
panels.description: OK / DEGRADED / KILLED - the governor both pagers read. The learning board explains why it moved.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Firewall trips by code
panels.description: Cumulative trips per firewall code - FW-070/080/081 are the data-staleness family. A step up is one new trip; codes are decoded in core/codes.py. Empty means: no firewall trip recorded.

defaults.noValue: no firewall trip recorded

panels.title: Decisions by family
panels.description: Reason-code volume per family (SZ sizing, PT pretrade, CV conviction, ...). One family suddenly dominating is a behavior change worth explaining. Empty means: this reason code has not fired.

defaults.noValue: this reason code has not fired

panels.title: Venue rejects
panels.description: Orders Kraken refused. Zero is normal; a burst usually means rate limits or malformed sizes. Resets on restart - a crash-loop reads 0; cross-check 'Cycles since restart'.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Dead-man failures
panels.description: Failed refreshes of the dead-man cancel timer that flattens orders if the bot goes silent. Resets on restart - a crash-loop reads 0; cross-check 'Cycles since restart'.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Exit-check failures
panels.description: Cycles where evaluating an exit crashed. Exits are the one thing that must never fail - any number here is urgent. Resets on restart; cross-check 'Cycles since restart'.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Cycle failures in a row
panels.description: Consecutive whole-cycle crashes. The loop retries, but a climb here means it is wedged on something. Resets on restart - a crash-loop reads 0; cross-check 'Cycles since restart'.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Model inference faults
panels.description: Times the model failed to score a candidate and the safe default was used instead. Resets on restart - a crash-loop reads 0; cross-check 'Cycles since restart'.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Feature-contract failures
panels.description: Feature rows that violated the model's input contract and were refused. Rising = the feed and the model disagree about the world's shape. Resets on restart - a crash-loop reads 0; cross-check 'Cycles since restart'.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Feed latency
panels.description: Round-trip time fetching market data. Slow feeds mean stale decisions.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Price marks age
panels.description: Age of the prices used to value open positions. Old marks mean the P&L numbers are guesses.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Kraken feed
panels.description: The live price stream. REST means degraded (polling) marks, not an outage.

defaults.noValue: ⚠ no series — exporter/pusher, not the bot

panels.title: Feed reconnects
panels.description: Times the websocket dropped and re-dialed since restart. A climb means an unstable link.

defaults.noValue: kraken websocket block not written

panels.title: Stale assets
panels.description: Assets whose market data has aged past the watchdog's limit. Their entries are blocked until data freshens.

defaults.noValue: watchdog block not in this status write

panels.title: Diverging feeds
panels.description: Assets where two data sources disagree about the price. The bot refuses to trade what it cannot price.

defaults.noValue: watchdog block not in this status write

panels.title: Critical data stale
panels.description: Whether any CRITICAL feed aged out. STALE blocks all new entries at once.

defaults.noValue: watchdog block not in this status write

panels.title: Books cross-check (live mode)
panels.description: Drift between reported equity and an independent recompute - BUT the recompute runs in LIVE mode only. In paper trading (dry-run, the current posture) it never runs and this reads 0.00 by construction: not a passed check, a check that never ran. Neutral color on purpose. In live mode, near zero means the accounting is telling the truth.

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write

panels.title: Telemetry
panels.description: Whether the status write has aged past the exporter's threshold. STALE = do not trust the numbers anywhere.

defaults.noValue: ⚠ no series — exporter/pusher, not the bot

panels.title: Runner
panels.description: Is the bot's own loop alive. STOPPED means everything else shown is the last known state, not the current one.

defaults.noValue: ⚠ no series — exporter/pusher, not the bot

panels.title: Daily loss budget used
panels.description: How much of today's allowed loss is spent. At 100% new trades stop until the day rolls over - the lockout state this board exists to explain.

defaults.noValue: risk-protocol stack not reporting

panels.title: Weekly loss budget used
panels.description: Same as the daily budget, over the trading week. NOTE: a capital sweep can inflate this falsely - see the budget_reanchor_week control verb.

defaults.noValue: risk-protocol stack not reporting

panels.title: Drawdown vs the hard stop
panels.description: The drawdown the catastrophe stop actually watches, against the line where it fires and flattens everything. Empty means: risk-protocol stack not reporting.

defaults.noValue: risk-protocol stack not reporting

panels.title: Size taper
panels.description: Multiplier on every new position's size. 1.00 full size; lower means the risk stack is shrinking trades.

defaults.noValue: risk-protocol stack not reporting

panels.title: Drawdown throttle
panels.description: Extra size cut applied while climbing out of a drawdown. 1.00 means no throttle.

defaults.noValue: risk-protocol stack not reporting

panels.title: Portfolio heat
panels.description: Total risk on the book if every stop filled, as a share of equity. The stack caps this near 35%.

defaults.noValue: risk-protocol stack not reporting

panels.title: Assets circuit-broken
panels.description: Assets benched for repeated losses. They sit out until their cooldown ends.

defaults.noValue: circuit-breaker ledger not written

panels.title: Circuit-breaker cooldown left
panels.description: Hours each benched asset still has to sit out. Empty with the tile at zero means nothing is benched - the good state.

defaults.noValue: no asset circuit-breaker tripped

panels.title: Loss streak by asset
panels.description: Consecutive losses per asset right now. Streaks are what trip the circuit breaker.

defaults.noValue: awaiting first close on this asset

panels.title: Audit writes dropped
panels.description: Audit-trail records that could not be written. The hash chain must never lose a link - any number here is urgent.

defaults.noValue: audit counters not in this status write

panels.title: Audit tail truncations
panels.description: Times a partial line was cut from the audit tail on recovery. Expected zero outside crash recovery.

defaults.noValue: audit counters not in this status write

panels.title: Bad values dropped by exporter
panels.description: NaN/Infinity values the telemetry exporter refused to push. Rising means something upstream is emitting garbage.

defaults.noValue: ⚠ no series — exporter/pusher, not the bot

panels.title: Cycles since restart
panels.description: Decision cycles since the runner last started - a restart shows as this resetting to zero (lifetime total: liquiditybot_cycle_lifetime).

defaults.noValue: not in this cycle's status write
